name: baitblocker
description: Browser extension that detects phishing pages and malicious URLs with local heuristics.

scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir packages --filename baitblocker-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir packages --filename baitblocker-chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
